headline: Rockrose refinanced its boutique office property at 11 East 26th Street with a $309 million, 10-year loan from Goldman Sachs.
The MTA board approved EMP Capital on Wednesday to build 375 apartments at 1119 Pacific Street in Crown Heights.
The state's housing agency updated its guidance, clarifying that rent concessions can be distinct from preferential rents.
The Department of Buildings issued stop-work orders on at least five projects tied to the engineers on last week's Flatbush collapse.
